cases.name: Janice Lynn Newport
cases.about: Her Go Fund Me said, "Mom passed standing up for herself and for her family. She was a strong woman -and a Navy veteran- who was fearless in times of adversity. She helped anyone and everyone in their time of need, and was a proud member of her church, the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter Day Saints in Oak Ridge, TN. She will always be remembered for her protective nature and unwavering kindness."
cases.narrative: He allegedly shot her, then refused to let officers give her medical aid during police standoff
